message.content: Triage started on your flagged energy violation — shrinking the scenario to isolate the failure.
Shrink pinpointed a high-speed two-body collision — now reconstructing its exact state.
Inspection shows a massive energy spike from what should be a simple collision — testing a counterfactual to confirm the cause.
